note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Description, biography and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Public profile details only. posts is the profile post count, not a dataset of posts. Followers and following are counts, not lists of people. Exact public follower counters are used; post counts may be rounded, as posts_approximate records. Private profiles, login responses and unrelated profile suggestions are not results.
